text:
Priya Patel: Pager alert — elevated 504s from services in az-b. PagerDuty incident 78945. Seeing outbound DNS timeouts to internal resolver 10.2.0.2. Can oncall take?
IncidentBot: @channel Incident triggered: PROD - network-high-latency (pager 78945) — severity P1 — assigned to Priya Patel
Sam Wu: I'm on it, pulling vpc flow logs and route table diffs
Priya Patel: quick note: we just rolled forward terraform change to NACLs in az-b ~ 10m ago
Diego Ramos: is that the NACL-wide deny-egress we tested for ip ranges? ...
Sam Wu: pulling tf state now
Sam Wu: tf plan shows :
```
resource "aws_network_acl_rule" "deny_outbound_test" {... cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0" egress = true rule_action = "deny"}
```
Sam Wu: looks like rule got applied to az-b private subnets across multiple route tables (unexpected)
Tess Lee: paging routing and infra-owned NAT autoscaling? Could NAT gateway replacement have been triggered? :thinking:
Diego Ramos: checking NAT health: NAT-gw-a (az-a) healthy, NAT-gw-b (az-b) unhealthy, autoscale attempted replacement and created NAT instance fallback
Support-Bot: Customer reports: 'Embeddings API timeouts' from eu-west cluster
Sam Wu: evidence points to split-horizon where NACL deny on egress dropped responses from customer resolvers causing conntrack asymmetry
Sam Wu: running iptables conntrack clear on nat-instance to heal
Sam Wu: command run:
```
sudo conntrack -L | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l
sudo conntrack -F
```
Priya Patel: attempted quick mitigation: remove deny rule from NACL in az-b; changing now
Priya Patel: removed rule at 2026-03-15T17:08:12Z
IncidentBot: Change event detected: NACL rule removed by Priya Patel (terraform apply)
Sam Wu: metrics back to baseline for outbound latency (graphs: https://grafana.redwood/prod/network/azb)
Tess Lee: customers still seeing intermittent 504s? Support says 5% of requests in EU for 12 minutes
Diego Ramos: DNS lookups to internal resolver show timeouts earlier — run traceroute
```
traceroute to 10.2.0.2 (10.2.0.2), 30 hops max
 1  10.1.0.1  0.4 ms
 2  10.2.0.2  * * *
```
Sam Wu: after NACL rule removal, traceroute returns
```
1 10.1.0.1 0.4 ms
2 10.2.0.2 1.0 ms
```
Tess Lee: I'm notifying accounts team for impacted customers and drafting status update
Support-Bot: Templates: 'We are aware of intermittent timeouts affecting embeddings and some external API calls in EU. Root cause: unintended NACL egress deny applied to some AZs. Mitigation: reverted NACL change and cleared connection tracking on NAT fallback instance. Services are recovering. We will follow up with postmortem.'
Priya Patel: escalation: network-eng please review terraform pipeline to prevent cross-az NACL rollouts
Network-Eng: added to triage, will audit pipeline and add guardrails
Sam Wu: planning postmortem — capturing timeline and runbook
Priya Patel: handing off to Tess (primary off-shift) for monitoring and customer comms at 17:30Z — Tess ack
Tess Lee: ack taking over. I'll keep the thread open and update every 10m until stable.
Priya Patel: thanks all — summary at close: cause NACL deny applied to az-b via terraform targeting bug, accidentally exported variable. Impact: outbound DNS/egress timeouts -> service 504s for small subset of EU customers for ~14m. Mitigation: removed rule, cleared conntrack, forced NAT to healthy gw. Postmortem owner: Sam
IncidentBot: Incident 78945 moved to 'monitoring' by Tess Lee
PagerDuty: Incident resolved? (pending) set status to 'stable' at 2026-03-15T17:45:00Z
Tess Lee: marking as stable; will create postmortem doc and link here
Sam Wu: adding checklist items: lock tf plan changes to per-az variables, add preapply diff alerts, add NACL apply sandbox
Diego Ramos: also add automated try-failback of NAT replacement when conntrack ratios spike
Support-Bot: Customer notification sent at 2026-03-15T17:50Z
Priya Patel: thanks team, closing oncall handoff
Tess Lee: closing thread, will post PM link: https://confluence.redwood/incident/78945
